title: Detecting and Reducing Bias in a High Stakes Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's over-reliance on non-semantic function/stop words (e.g., 'a', 'on') by using a leave-one-out method to find influential tokens, calculating a 'Rationale Rank' to compare model focus against human expert annotations, and measuring prediction flip rates on adversarial examples generated by inserting neutral unigrams into text.
